Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics

Discover the sophisticated performance and refined luxury of this 2023 BMW 5 Series 530i xDrive, a sedan that delivers dynamic driving capability with premium comfort and advanced technology seamlessly integrated into every detail.

- Remote Engine Start
- 19" W-Spoke Bi-Color Wheels with All-Season Tires
- Heated Steering Wheel

This xDrive model combines all-wheel drive capability with a 2.0L turbocharged 4-cylinder engine paired to an 8-speed automatic sport transmission, achieving 23 city and 32 highway miles per gallon. The responsive handling and efficient performance make every drive purposeful, whether navigating city streets or highway corridors with confidence and control.

The interior showcases premium Sensatec upholstery paired with gray poplar wood trim accents throughout the cabin. Power-adjustable front sport seats with lumbar support provide individualized comfort for both driver and passenger, while the heated steering wheel adds a welcoming touch during cooler months. The power moonroof bathes the cabin in natural light, creating an open and inviting atmosphere.

Technology elevates the driving experience through the Live Cockpit Pro system featuring integrated navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and SiriusXM satellite radio with a one-year subscription included. Enhanced USB and Bluetooth connectivity keeps you seamlessly linked to your digital world, while the BMW Assist eCall emergency communication system and ConnectedDrive services provide added peace of mind on every journey.

Safety and convenience features work together to support confident driving. The four-wheel independent suspension system provides responsive handling, while brake assist, electronic stability control, and traction control deliver stability when you need it most. Auto high-beam headlights, rain-sensing wipers, and a rear parking camera contribute to overall awareness and control in varying conditions.

With an original MSRP of $61,645, this 530i xDrive with 16,547 miles represents an opportunity to own a meticulously crafted luxury sedan that continues to deliver the performance and refinement BMW owners expect. The gray metallic exterior finish complements the sophisticated presence this vehicle commands on any road.

All prices are for retail purchase financed through BMWFS.

This 2023 Mercedes-Benz C-Class C 300 4MATIC® in White combines refined German engineering with practical daily performance, offering you a certified pre-owned luxury sedan that delivers both sophistication and reliability.

The C 300 4MATIC® is equipped with comprehensive features designed for comfort and convenience:

- 2.0L I4 Turbocharged engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission and 4MATIC® all-wheel drive
- 11.9" Center Touchscreen Display with Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto®
- Premium audio system: MBUX with SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Power Heated Front Seats with Memory and Heated Steering Wheel
- MB-Tex Upholstery with Front Bucket Seats and Premium Trim Package
- Automatic temperature control with Front dual zone A/C
- Power moonroof for enhanced open-air driving
- 18" 5-Spoke Alloy wheels
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear with GUARD 360 security system
- Electronic Stability Control with 4-Wheel Independent Suspension
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Delay-off function and Rear fog lights
- Brake assist with 4-Wheel Disc Brakes and ABS
- Emergency communication system: Mercedes-Benz Emergency Call Service
- Split folding rear seat for versatile cargo management

This C 300 delivers an EPA-estimated 24 city and 33 highway mpg, providing balanced efficiency for both urban commutes and longer drives. The 4MATIC® all-wheel drive system ensures confident handling across various road conditions, while the turbocharged engine generates responsive performance without sacrificing practical fuel economy.

Mercedes-Benz Certified Pre-Owned certification provides exceptional peace of mind:

- 165+ Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $0
- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History
- Limited Warranty: 12 Month/Unlimited Mile beginning after new car warranty expires or from certified purchase date
- Includes Trip Interruption Reimbursement and 7 days/500 miles Exchange Privilege

The interior is meticulously appointed with genuine wood dashboard insert, Piano Black Lacquer Center Console, and premium materials throughout. Convenience features include power-adjustable driver's seat with lumbar support, auto tilt-away steering wheel, HomeLink garage door transmitter, and illuminated entry to greet you at night. The memory seat and steering wheel functions allow you to save your preferred driving position for seamless transitions between drivers.

Safety is a priority with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbag, knee airbag, and child-seat-sensing technology. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and power-adjustable front head restraints enhance occupant protection during unexpected events.

Weather-responsive features include rain sensing wipers with variable intermittent control, heated door mirrors with auto-dimming capability, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror that reduces glare during night driving. The rear window defroster and all-weather floor mats prepare this sedan for whatever conditions you encounter.

This Mercedes-Benz C-Class represents the opportunity to own a certified luxury vehicle with verified history, comprehensive warranty protection, and the confidence that comes with manufacturer-backed certification. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this sophisticated sedan firsthand.

This 2023 Toyota Camry XSE V6 delivers the combination of performance and refinement you've been looking for in a midsize sedan.

- 3.5L V6 DOHC engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- Navigation Package with 9" touch-screen, dynamic navigation, and premium JBL audio system
- Driver Assist Package featuring rear cross traffic braking, intelligent clearance sonar, and bird's eye view camera
- Cold Weather Package with heated steering wheel
- Multi-stage ventilated front bucket seats with perforated leather trim
- Two-tone exterior color with midnight black metallic roof, rear spoiler, and black window trim
- Power moonroof for an open-air driving experience
- Heated front seats and power-adjustable driver and passenger seats
- All-weather floor liners and cargo tray for interior protection
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility with hands-free phone capability
- SiriusXM satellite radio with three-month all access trial included
- Rear dual USB power ports for convenient device charging
- Alloy wheels measuring 8.0J x 19"

With 41,630 miles, this Camry remains well-maintained and ready for years of dependable service. The V6 engine provides responsive acceleration and delivers an impressive 22 mpg in the city and 32 mpg on the highway, balancing performance with fuel efficiency. The bold red exterior sets this sedan apart while the sophisticated two-tone design with midnight black accents adds visual depth and character.

The XSE V6 trim level equips you with premium comfort features designed for longer drives. The multi-stage ventilated front seats adjust to your preferences, while the heated steering wheel ensures comfort during colder months. The heads-up display projects critical driving information directly onto your windshield, minimizing distractions and keeping your focus on the road ahead.

Technology integration is seamless in this vehicle. The nine-speaker JBL premium audio system reproduces your music with clarity and depth. Navigation with a three-year trial keeps you confidently on course, while Safety Connect provides emergency communication services with a one-year trial. Remote Connect and Wi-Fi connectivity features add modern convenience to your daily drives.

Safety and control are paramount in this Camry's design. The bird's eye view camera provides a comprehensive perspective of your surroundings when parking or maneuvering in tight spaces. Intelligent clearance sonar alerts you to obstacles, and rear cross traffic braking actively assists when backing out of parking spots. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering work together to deliver composed handling through varied road conditions.

The intelligent details throughout this vehicle demonstrate Toyota's commitment to thoughtful design. Illuminated door sill enhancements welcome you with style, while the trunk LED bulb and illuminated entry features provide practical visibility. All-weather floor liners and cargo tray protect your interior investment, and the garage door transmitter allows convenient home integration.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this 2023 Camry XSE V6 firsthand. Our team is prepared to answer your questions and help you understand why this vehicle represents an excellent choice for your next purchase.

This 2023 Lexus ES 250 Premium Package with Lexus Interface Cloud Navigation offers a refined driving experience that balances sophistication with everyday practicality.

- Lexus Interface Cloud Navigation with 12.3" color multimedia touch-screen display
- Premium Package including heated and ventilated seats with driver memory
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- Leather-appointed interior with heated leather steering wheel
- Power Tilt/Telescoping Steering Wheel with Memory
- All-Weather Floor Liners with Trunk Tray
- 18" Split-10-Spoke Alloy Wheels with 2-tone black machined finish
- Intuitive Parking Assist with auto braking and rear cross-traffic alert
- Wireless Charger for compatible devices
- Power moonroof
- Rain Sensing Wipers and windshield deicer
- SmartAccess Key Card with easy entry
- Wood Trim with ambient lighting
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 10 speakers
- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off feature

The ES 250 is powered by a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering 25 mpg in city driving and 34 mpg on the highway. The black exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that works in any setting.

The Premium Package elevates your ownership experience with thoughtful comfort features. Heated and ventilated seats adjust to your preferences, while the power-folding outside mirrors with memory settings personalize the driving position. The wireless charger keeps your phone ready for navigation or music streaming, and the intuitive parking assist simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces with both visual guidance and automatic braking support.

Inside, the cabin reflects quality craftsmanship with wood trim accents and ambient lighting that creates a welcoming atmosphere. The leather steering wheel is heated for cold mornings, and the power moonroof brings natural light and openness to the driving environment. The Lexus Interface system provides seamless smartphone integration through wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, ensuring your music, navigation, and communication apps are always accessible.

Safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and an overhead airbag system. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together with speed-sensing steering to maintain control on various road conditions. The exterior parking camera provides clear visibility when backing up or navigating tight areas.

This ES 250 represents a practical choice for drivers who value comfort, technology, and dependable performance. With its balanced fuel economy, comprehensive feature set, and reputation for reliability, this sedan provides the confidence you need for both daily commutes and longer drives.

Speed-sensing wipers adapt to weather conditions, and the rear window defroster clears visibility quickly. Four-wheel independent suspension with auto-leveling technology maintains composure on varied road surfaces.

Safety systems work quietly in the background. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes provide confidence during maneuvers and sudden stops. Dual front impact airbags, front and rear side curtain airbags, and occupant sensing technology establish multiple layers of protection. The exterior parking camera aids visibility when reversing, while BMW Assist eCall provides emergency communication capabilities.

The MBUX premium audio system ensures your music sounds exceptional during every drive.

Dual-zone front air conditioning ensures both driver and passenger comfort, and the rear window defroster supports visibility in all conditions.

Safety and convenience work together throughout this sedan. The parking assist package simplifies tight spaces, while the exterior rearview camera provides clear sightlines when backing up. The Emergency Call Service connects you to assistance when needed, and comprehensive airbag technology throughout the cabin protects occupants. Electronic stability control and traction control work constantly to maintain grip and vehicle dynamics.

This Mercedes-Benz C-Class C 300 represents an opportunity to own a sophisticated, well-maintained sedan that balances luxury with practical everyday utility. Visit our showroom to experience the quality and refinement this vehicle offers firsthand.

This 2023 Genesis G70 2.0T sedan in Savile Silver represents a refined balance of performance and sophisticated design, ready to elevate your daily driving experience.

- Sport Prestige Package with premium amenities
- Lexicon Premium Audio System with 15 speakers and dual subwoofers
- 5th generation navigation system with 10.25 touchscreen, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- 19 sport alloy wheels with all-season performance
- Wide sunroof for natural light and open-air atmosphere
- Heated and ventilated front seats with leather seating surfaces
- Integrated Memory System for driver seat, mirrors, and steering column
- Wireless device charging pad
- Forward and reverse parking distance warning
- Power folding mirrors with rain-sensing wipers
- Heated steering wheel

- Genesis Connected Services with emergency communication system

Powered by an efficient I4 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, this G70 delivers responsive performance while achieving 20 city and 28 highway mpg. The AWD system provides stability and control across various road conditions, while the SHIFTRONIC transmission offers manual control when you desire a more engaging drive.

The Sport Prestige Package elevates this sedan with substantial comfort and convenience features. Premium Lexicon audio surround sound, a dynamic navigation system with connected routing and over-the-air updates, and a wide sunroof create an environment designed for both commanding the road and enjoying the journey. Heated and ventilated front seats, along with a heated steering wheel, ensure comfort during all seasons.

Technology throughout this G70 reflects Genesiss commitment to connectivity and control. Dual-zone automatic temperature control, HomeLink garage door transmitter functionality, and a comprehensive airbag system including dual front, front side, knee, and overhead protection work together to support your safety and convenience daily.

The sedans sport-focused exterior includes dark chrome grille and daylight opening trim, Genesis logo puddle lamps, and 19-inch sport alloy wheels that communicate its refined performance character. Inside, sport aluminum trim accents complement the leather seating surfaces, creating an interior that balances luxury with purposeful design.

At just over 26,000 miles, this low-mileage G70 offers the advantages of Genesiss warranty coverage while maintaining like-new condition throughout. The Sport Prestige Package and comprehensive feature set make this sedan an excellent choice for discerning drivers seeking reliability, comfort, and contemporary design.

  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. - Heated rear seats

Advanced technology is seamlessly integrated throughout. The Sensus Navigation system provides reliable route guidance, while the high-performance audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio and smartphone integration keeps you connected. HomeLink garage door control and the exterior parking camera add convenience and safety to daily driving.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, anti-whiplash front head restraints, and a comprehensive airbag system. Auto high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers adapt to changing conditions automatically. The low tire pressure warning system helps maintain optimal vehicle performance.

We are conveniently located in Burnsville, MN and proudly serve the Shakopee, Bloomington, Lakeville, Apple Valley.

The rear-wheel-drive configuration contributes to responsive handling, while the four-wheel independent suspension ensures a composed ride over varied road conditions. Safety and convenience features reflect Mercedes-Benz engineering standards, including a comprehensive airbag system with knee and occupant-sensing capabilities, electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist technology. The exterior parking camera, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, and surround view system enhance visibility and parking confidence. HomeLink garage door integration and illuminated door sills add thoughtful daily conveniences.

This vehicle includes the following certification benefits:

- 165+ Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance

- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History

The interior combines MB-Tex upholstery with genuine wood dashboard appointments, creating an elevated aesthetic complemented by leather steering wheel details and ambient lighting throughout. Memory functions for seats and steering wheel settings allow quick personalization for multiple drivers, while the comprehensive sound system delivers quality audio for your daily commute or longer journeys.

The exterior presentation features body-color bumpers, alloy wheels, and a sleek black finish that maintains its presence through varied lighting conditions. Heated door mirrors and fully automatic headlights provide practical enhancements for seasonal driving changes.

We invite you to visit our showroom to evaluate this C 300 firsthand and discover how its combination of luxury, technology, and thoughtful engineering aligns with your automotive needs.

Experience the perfect blend of luxury, efficiency, and advanced technology with this 2024 Lexus ES 300h sedan. Dressed in sophisticated Cloudburst Gray exterior, this used vehicle offers a refined look that stands out. The black interior features Hadori Aluminum Trim, complementing the sleek design and providing a premium feel. Powered by a 2.5-liter naturally aspirated four-cylinder hybrid engine, it delivers an impressive 215 horsepower while achieving up to 43 mpg in the city and 44 mpg on the highway. This front-wheel-drive sedan combines smooth performance with outstanding fuel economy, making it an ideal choice for both daily commuting and longer drives.

Equipped with the Premium Package, this Lexus ES 300h elevates comfort and convenience. Heated and ventilated front seats ensure year-round comfort, while rain-sensing windshield wipers with de-icer enhance safety in adverse weather. The Lexus memory system and easy access driver's seat with power tilt-and-telescopic heated leather steering wheel add personalized ease. Parking is simplified with intuitive assist featuring auto braking and rear cross traffic alert. Additional features include a wireless charger, fast-response interior heater, power-folding outside mirrors, and elegant interior wood trim. This sedan also comes with a range of driver-assist and connectivity features such as adaptive cruise control, Apple CarPlay, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, Bluetooth, collision warning, cross traffic alert, keyless entry, lane keep assist, push start, satellite radio readiness, and WiFi hotspot, ensuring a safe and connected drive.

2024 Lexus ES 300h Safety and Security Features

This model prioritizes safety with dual front knee airbags, traffic sign recognition, and a regenerative braking system that enhances efficiency. It is equipped with four-wheel anti-lock brakes (ABS), anti-lockout power door locks, auto-locking doors for added security, and an electronic parking brake that automatically releases, offering peace of mind and confidence on the road.

2024 Lexus ES 300h Entertainment and Technology Features

Stay connected and entertained with a comprehensive suite of features. Voice-operated hands-free phone call integration and HD radio provide seamless communication and listening options. The premium 10-speaker audio system delivers crisp sound, while an 8-inch touch screen infotainment display offers easy control. Smartphone app functions enable engine start and cabin preconditioning, and electronic messaging assistance, both read and voice-operated, keep you informed on the go. Additional connectivity options include a USB auxiliary input, making this sedan as versatile as it is luxurious.
